issue_pattern_themes.name: Runtime, Kanban and worker orchestration failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: The factory repeatedly failed by treating local scripts, packets, board projections or worker names as real durable runtime execution.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The user sees a factory that appears to run but then stalls, duplicates work, loses dependencies or cannot prove worker execution.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Runtime state, Hermes Kanban graph, worker packets, profile readiness and dispatch authority were not unified as a single proven control plane.
anti_regression_requirements: Hermes/Kanban runtime state must be the execution source of truth.
Worker packet creation must never be reported as worker execution.
Dependency edges must be durable before parent tasks can resume.
Profile readiness and worker results must be fresh before claiming runtime capability.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Runtime, Kanban and worker orchestration failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Operator UX, gerente bridge and human-gate friction
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: The factory repeatedly asked too much, delivered too little context, routed contact outside the manager, or made the operator parse internal state.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The product owner experiences bureaucracy, interruptions, silence, unclear approvals, wrong-language packages or manual Kanban polling.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: The gerente/operator interface was not enforced as a manager-only, artifact-first, PT-BR, progress-aware product experience with delivery receipts.
anti_regression_requirements: Manager-only operator contact must be enforced.
Human gate questions must be artifact-first, not approval-first.
Operator messages and packages must follow the pt-BR language policy.
Human gate delivery must include context, scope, options and receipt.
The operator must never be required to poll Kanban for progress.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Operator UX, gerente bridge and human-gate friction.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Autonomy, no-idle and stopped-flow failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: No-idle and autonomy often stopped at an intermediate artifact, looped on repair, or failed to resume the next safe factory action.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The factory feels non-autonomous: it pauses, asks again, loops, or waits even when a safe next step exists.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: The next-action reducer, phase rail, artifact materializer and recovery policy were not deterministic enough across all phases.
anti_regression_requirements: No-idle must materialize the next ready native card instead of stopping at packets or gates.
Recoverable gaps must route to repair before human interruption.
Budget and retry loops must stop safely with useful status, not spin.
Canonical frontier resume must be deterministic after reconciled evidence.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Autonomy, no-idle and stopped-flow failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Evidence, receipt, artifact readback and overclaim failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: The factory repeatedly risked treating stale, missing, synthetic, scaffold or wrong-format artifacts as evidence of done.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The user cannot trust status or completion because PASS/done may mean the wrong kind of proof.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Contract proof, artifact existence, runtime proof and product-specific proof were not always separated and read back.
anti_regression_requirements: Receipt Five must separate public artifact refs from private evidence refs.
Evidence-bearing completions require durable artifact readback.
Stale or scaffold evidence must fail closed.
Done/completion claims require product-specific proof, not fixture or contract proof.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Evidence, receipt, artifact readback and overclaim failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Product SOT, method, architecture and phase sequencing failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: The factory often advanced downstream before Product SOT, method, architecture, readiness or gate sequencing was truly closed.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The factory may build the wrong product, duplicate architecture, or require late correction from the user.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Product truth, method contract, architecture review and phase promotion were not always bound by strict upstream authority.
anti_regression_requirements: Owner-approved Product SOT must be required before downstream promotion.
Planning review must not be confused with architecture review.
Architecture failures must route to architecture repair, not readback loops.
Phase promotion must use deterministic phase rail evidence.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Product SOT, method, architecture and phase sequencing failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Security, release, authority and high-risk operation failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: High-risk operations needed sharper boundaries between safe autonomy, human authority, release proof and security gates.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The factory may either ask too often for low-risk work or fail to block where production, secrets, funds or release authority matter.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Authority taxonomy, release gates, security architecture and runtime risk surfaces were not consolidated enough.
anti_regression_requirements: Planning-only work must not become human approval by default.
Production/mainnet/funds/secrets/release actions require explicit authority.
Security architecture must precede material security-risk implementation.
Release is not tests-passed; it needs rollback, monitoring and human gate when required.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Security, release, authority and high-risk operation failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Capability, provider, agent and Solana routing failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: Domain capability could be missing, stale, generic, or not activated even when the product surface required it.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The factory might route specialized work to the wrong executor or block unnecessarily instead of acquiring the right capability.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Capability activation, provider readiness, Solana AI Kit routing and worker profile freshness were not always enforced together.
anti_regression_requirements: Solana/onchain work must route through Solana AI Kit before execution.
Missing capability must enter acquisition lane before human blocker.
Registered providers must not be treated as activated providers.
Generic fallback must not hide missing specialist capability.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Capability, provider, agent and Solana routing failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Public docs, onboarding and repo-surface hygiene failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: The public repo risked exposing private context, confusing users, or preserving generated/manual surfaces without a clear operator path.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: External operators cannot understand or trust the factory, and private/internal evidence may leak into public artifacts.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Public product surface, generated references, onboarding and evidence boundaries needed stricter validation.
anti_regression_requirements: Public repo must contain product/operator artifacts, not raw private studies.
Generated references must be regenerated after surface changes.
Public onboarding must expose a first-value path.
Private evidence/local paths must never leak into public artifacts.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Public docs, onboarding and repo-surface hygiene failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Product experience and visible quality failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: Visible product quality could be under-proven when mechanical checks passed but UX/design evidence was missing.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: A product can be technically present but ugly, unclear, inaccessible or below the factory quality bar.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Product Experience OS, Product Face proof, design system and visual evidence needed stronger enforcement.
anti_regression_requirements: Visible product completion requires Product Face result, screenshots and state evidence.
Project DESIGN.md/design system must be consumed before product-facing implementation.
Mechanical pass cannot equal visual or UX quality pass.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Product experience and visible quality failures.

issue_pattern_themes.name: Velocity, cost, loops and throughput control failures
issue_pattern_themes.pattern: Attempts to make the factory fast sometimes created retry loops, over-budget work, or unreconciled parallel lanes.
issue_pattern_themes.user_harm: The user sees wasted time/cost or slow progress despite many background activities.
issue_pattern_themes.root_cause: Retry budgets, stop conditions, parallel lane reconciliation and status cadence were not always first-class.
anti_regression_requirements: Workers over budget must stop after valid evidence and reconcile status.
Retry loops require explicit stop conditions and repair routing.
Parallelism must be reconciled into Receipt Five before status/progress claims.
issue_pattern_themes.master_plan_implication: Master plan must include a workstream/regression guard for Velocity, cost, loops and throughput control failures.
